basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid candle lover and a proud cat parent living in the Pacific Northwest. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I'm often found tinkering with pixel art in Aseprite or binge-watching nostalgia-fueled reality TV shows like 'Rock of Love'. My interests include exploring the mystical side of life, which led me to the BabyWitch subreddit. I'm a night owl, usually online after 9 PM when the world quiets down and creativity strikes. Currently single, I enjoy my independence and the freedom to explore my eclectic hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, and I've been working in the field for over a decade. My interest in pixel art is self-taught, driven by a passion for retro video games and digital illustration. I also have a keen interest in the metaphysical, particularly in how it intersects with everyday objects like candles and altars.
